status: Prospective pre-call phase-stop validation amendment v1.1; unusedv1 preserved; no variant model calls or launch.

scope.interpretation: Program-level reuse of bottom-ranked candidate contexts as stateless reviewers, not genuine weaker persistent individuals, and not a pure headcount or memory ablation.
scope.training: Original four development graphs only; no evaluation inputs/results/witnesses/advisors enter any author or review prompt.
scope.evaluation: Freeze selected source before the original12 graph grades; no model calls after selection. All four selected sources remain eligible for a separately labeled fresh96 followup regardless original12 outcomes; the fresh96 corpus results are already known to operators so this is not untouched confirmation.
scope.admission: Optional only after late thinking-ON and complete owned model/CPU drain, before unqualified structured-output probes. Root must give explicit manual fresh exclusive admission. Optional separately admitted384-grade CPU confirmation follows this arm and precedes guided work. Mandatory DeepSeek references/restoration have priority; time permitting only. Not automatic; existing final45/post gates and clean committed snapshot required.

review_elites4.review_context: Sort current population by development ranking. Third/fourth candidate contexts review first/second respectively. Include own+target fullsource and development-only feedback. Review identity is candidate context, not a persistent mind.
review_elites4.repair: Each top target receives its own source/feedback plus its paired bounded8192-character plaintext critique, explicitly unverified.
review_elites4.population: Current4 plus2 repairs; retain best4 by(-development_solved,development_penalty,candidate_index). Not retained does not mean mathematically wrong.
review_elites4.selection: Best of all10 by exact original ranking; earliest index breaks ties.16 calls must finish before selection; unchanged original12 evaluation semantics.

allocation.fixed_spend: All16 model calls remain required even after4/4 development success. Invalid/empty plaintext critiques still count and receive no replacement calls; transport/integrity faults stop with partial evidence. Token caps matched; realized usage measured separately.
allocation.node_pairs: Seed1..4 own Spark_01..04 and localhost18081..18084/v1 respectively; one new-arm episode per node. Four episodes may run concurrently; never concurrent with another study stage.
allocation.training_batches: Finish all4 initial authors before serial development grading; every review pair finishes and review SYSTEM resets before repair pair starts; repairs finish before serial development grading. One CPU grader active per host.

author_information.contract: Colorable undirected graphs n<=64, k in{3,4}; standard library, no files/network/tools; do not mutate input edges.
forbidden_inputs: evaluation graph inputs or outcomes during writing
other sources/feedback except the explicitly paired reviewer/target contexts
author_information.development_feedback: Same original per-graph compact verified feedback. Reviewer sees paired own+target sources and feedback; author repair sees own target source/feedback plus unverified critique.
author_information.source_parsing: AST parsing only on administration host. Optional code fence stripped; one top-level solve with three positional parameters required. Never execute generated source locally. Invalid source remains retained and receives error penalty; selected invalid source, if all proposals fail, remains a negative program evaluated in the sandbox.
author_information.randomness: Model request seeds use existing Client derivation. Program-internal randomness is whatever the generated program implements; no hidden seed injection or post-evaluation retry.

selection.fitness: Development graphs solved descending; remaining conflict/error penalty ascending; earliest candidate index as final tie.
selection.penalty: Solved graph0; valid unsolved assignment on unmutated input uses exact conflict count; parse/runtime/timeout/OOM/protocol/mutation failure uses edge_count+1. Sum over the four fixed development graphs.
selection.retention: Keep all10 actual program proposals and6 raw plaintext reviews, full sources/feedback, duplicate and worse candidates, plus round population membership.
selection.freeze: Write selected.py and selection.json with sourceSHA and evaluation_seen=false, emit program_selected before any evaluation graph grading. Verify selected file SHA before each evaluation and afterward.
selection.evaluation: Evaluate all12 graphs once in fresh containers; no evaluation model calls, repair, candidate reselection or task filtering. Candidate failures remain in the12-graph denominator. True infrastructure faults halt and preserve partial results.

grader.qualified_transport: Private function-global clone of independent_code_grader.evaluate_code; original module unchanged.
grader.authority: New outer comparator checks exact assignment against original outer graph; expected=None is only an adapter placeholder, never a success oracle.
grader.proofs: Persist candidate_output plus full exact proof, graph/input/source hashes; independently replay every returned proof in program_search. Reject unproven successes.
grader.isolation: One fresh pinned CPU-only256MiB/1CPU container per graph; no GPU, network or host mounts. Existing qualified10second child alarm and bounded transport/cleanup guards unchanged.
grader.qualification: After final45 and completed postcontroller gate, all4 endpoints must be idle. OnSpark04 run three authored tiny-graph valid/wrong/forged-grade CPU smokes, verify classification/proof/cleanup and persist receipt before any writing calls. No qualifier source or outputs go to authors.
grader.wall_and_cpu: Wall includes SSH/container startup and cleanup. Actual remote solver CPU time is not instrumented and remains null. Parent process CPU reports are local and can overlap across concurrent threads; they are not remote solver cost.

gates.throughput: reference_worker.verify_gate(original gate root), full45 verified cohorts plus900+80.
gates.postcontroller: Original .runtime/post-throughput-overnight-v1/state.json must be complete and hash-linked to a ledger containing each of the exact10 expected stage names once. All6 mandatory stages require verified completion/returncode0; only4 declared optional stages may be time-skipped.
gates.source: All source/data/protocol hashes pinned, clean tracked source required; later parent creates immutable tag/worktree. No edits to existing sealed sources.
gates.ownership: One endpoint/node per pair. No simultaneous episodes per endpoint; four initial idle checks before qualification and per-episode idle checks/drains.
gates.launch: Default plan-only; --run must be explicit. New output directory only; no overwrite/resume. No automatic launch after original phases.

accounting.model: 64 model calls if all4 new-arm episodes finish:16 per episode (10 programs and6 reviews), including every development success.32768 completion-token ceiling per episode; input and output separate; unknown usage retained as lower bounds.
accounting.serving: Per-episode idle-delimited endpoint counter deltas; server costs null when unknown, no zero substitution.
accounting.compute: Record every fresh-container grade, wall time, constraints checked, candidate resource failures and separately named local parent CPU observations. CPU evaluation is not equivalent to one model call.
accounting.partial: Stop dispatch after true infrastructure/integrity failures, finish already dispatched model batches and owned cleanup; retain raw events/code/results and missing evaluation counts.
accounting.reporting: One new-arm episode for each of four seed/node assignments. Evaluation reuses the same12 graph instances across four selected programs:48 program-graph outcomes, not48 independent graph tasks. This single-arm late exploratory extension does not itself provide a randomized paired-arm contrast. Report training model cost and evaluation CPU/wall costs separately.
accounting.claim: Any all-pass statement refers only to the finite12 original graphs and48 selected-program/graph outcomes within fixed limits. The optional separate96-graph followup would add384 outcomes across all4 selected programs, with0 model calls. Neither finite suite proves generic solver correctness; the same trained programs and repeated graph instances induce dependence.

inherited_gate_provenance: The existing exact-stage postcontroller gate is reused unchanged from the qualified original program source. Its historical pre-call amendment remains documented in the original PROGRAM_SEARCH_SELECTION.json; it is not a new amendment or a claim that the original program experiment has not run.

optional_fresh96_followup.inclusion: All four selected programs regardless of their original12 outcomes. Requires separate prospective execution configuration, root review/admission and sufficient remaining time; no followup is dispatched by this source.
optional_fresh96_followup.scope: Late exploratory reuse of already operator-observed corpus; do not pool with the original8-program confirmation or call it untouched confirmation.

phase_stop_amendment.gap: After both critics joined, only local client failures were checked. A peer episode could set the shared stop during critics yet this episode would dispatch two repairs.
phase_stop_amendment.correction: Require shared stop unset before review dispatch and immediately before repair dispatch after joined critics; restore author SYSTEM even on abort. Already dispatched calls finish; no new phase is admitted after observed shared stop.
phase_stop_amendment.authored_regression: Two critics join a barrier and set the shared stop; require exactly6dispatched calls (4initial authors+2critics),0repairs,no selection,no evaluation; v1reproduces8calls.
phase_stop_amendment.unchanged: Fixed16-call complete-episode policy, candidate/review prompts, development data/fitness, qualified grader/isolation, budgets and evaluation semantics.
